name: family-education-learning-planner
description: Turns a two-year family-education learning outline into a rolling, evaluable, traceable monthly system: initialises the state directory, plans and revises monthly learning, records daily study and home practice, archives every produced artefact into a traceable ledger, runs weekly reviews and month-end six-dimension scoring with veto checks, and converts the weakest dimension into evidence-backed next-period advice — never inventing progress the learner did not actually make.

displayDescription.en: Turns a two-year learning outline into an executable, evaluable, traceable monthly system — planning, archiving, scoring, and next-step advice.
displayDescription.zh: 把两年学习总纲变成可执行、可评估、可追溯的月度系统：规划学习、归档成果、复盘评分、给出下阶段建议。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 初始化我的家庭教育学习系统，从两年总纲开始。
defaultInitPrompt.en: Initialise my family-education learning system, starting from the two-year outline.

quickPrompts.en: Initialise my family-education learning system, starting from the two-year outline.
quickPrompts.zh: 初始化我的家庭教育学习系统，从两年总纲开始。

quickPrompts.en: Organise this month's learning artefacts and register them in the ledger.
quickPrompts.zh: 把这个月的学习成果整理归档，登记进成果台账。

quickPrompts.en: Assess whether this month met the bar, then propose next month's plan based on the weakest dimension.
quickPrompts.zh: 评估本月是否达标，并按短板给出下月计划。
